meta.parties: Holland Colombo Ltd. of Colombo v. Subramaniam

rules.statement: A contract that begins as an agency agreement cannot be construed as a sale for the purpose of imposing vendor liability on the agent, unless there is clear provision in the contract indicating such liability.
rules.supporting_quote: "It was I think with this comment in mind that Ennis A.C.J. in Darley Butler' s case expressed himself as follows :\n \" The later cases all seem to indicate that the proposition in Ireland v. Livingston has but a limited application, and that a contract of agency remains throughout a contract of agency, but that for certain purposes it is assimilated to a contract of sale".
